full_prompt_en: A square photorealistic painting shows a white-suited astronaut suspended in an empty black void. The figure fills the middle and upper part of the frame, curled as if drifting without gravity. A large rounded helmet sits at the upper left of the body, with its faceplate almost entirely black and no facial features visible. The torso twists toward the viewer, one arm extending down and left with gloved fingers spread, while the other arm bends outward to the right. One knee pulls up across the center; the other leg angles down and right, ending in a heavy boot. Layers of cream-white fabric, padded joints, straps, small equipment pockets, and a compact pack give the suit considerable physical volume. Wrinkles gather at the elbows, waist, knees, and ankles, with seams and darker gaps articulating how the clothing bends. The surrounding field is unbroken near-black, without stars, spacecraft, horizon, or readable marking. This absence of context makes the body feel isolated and the pose more ambiguous. Warm directional light from the upper left strikes the helmet, shoulder, thigh, and upper boot, turning the suit beige and pale gold in the brightest places. Deep brown shadows collect under the arms, inside the joints, and across the lower side, while the visor remains a dark reflective oval. The rendering is meticulous but painterly, with subtle surface grain and softened shadow edges rather than a sterile studio cutout. The overall composition is tense and weightless, holding one complex human silhouette in a vast field of darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形照片般写实绘画呈现一名穿白色宇航服的人悬在空无的黑色虚空里。人物填满中部与上方，身体蜷曲，如同失重漂浮。大圆头盔位于身体左上，面罩几乎全黑，看不见五官。躯干朝观者扭转，一条手臂向左下伸出，戴手套的手指张开；另一条手臂向右弯出。一边膝盖收在中央，另一条腿斜向右下，末端是厚靴。奶油白织物、填充关节、皮带、小装备袋与紧凑背包层层叠加，赋予宇航服明显实体体积。手肘、腰、膝与踝部堆起皱纹，接缝和深色缝隙说明衣服如何弯曲。周围是完整近黑色域，没有星、飞船、地平线或可读标记。这种环境缺失让身体显得孤立，姿态也更加难以判断。暖定向光从左上方照到头盔、肩、大腿与靴上部，使最亮处的白衣呈米色和浅金色。手臂下、关节内与身体下侧聚着深棕阴影，面罩则保持深色反光椭圆。渲染细密却有绘画感，带细微表面颗粒和柔化阴影边，而非无菌影棚剪贴。整体构图紧张且失重，将一个复杂人体剪影悬在广阔黑暗中。
style_prompt_en: Photorealistic painting concentrates meticulous material folds and warm directional light on one pale floating form within extensive black negative space. Ivory, beige, and muted gold highlights turn into deep brown joints and recesses, making volume feel heavy even without visible support. Surface detail is sharp where light catches seams and padding, softer at shadow boundaries. The surrounding darkness has almost no texture, increasing isolation and visual tension. An asymmetric curled silhouette gives the otherwise simple frame motion. The overall effect is precise, quiet, and unsettling.
style_prompt_zh: 照片般写实绘画把细密材质衣褶和暖定向光集中于广阔黑色负空间中的一个浅色漂浮形体。象牙、米色和柔金亮部转入深棕关节与凹处，使没有可见支撑的体积仍显沉重。接缝与填充处受光时细节清晰，阴影边界较柔。周围黑暗几乎没有纹理，增强孤立感与视觉张力。不对称蜷曲剪影让简单画框产生动势。整体精确、安静且令人不安。
theme_en: A white-suited astronaut suspended against a black void
theme_zh: 一名穿白色宇航服的人悬浮在黑色虚空前
name: Jeremy Geddes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
